tagline.en: A bridge between Zigbee devices and MQTT, with no proprietary hub — no coordinator plugged in yet (see its notes in the panel)
tagline.pt: Ponte entre dispositivos Zigbee e MQTT, sem hub proprietário — sem coordenador ligado ainda (veja as notas dele no painel)

configuration.yaml.note: Read by the app, never written by it: the destination is inside a volume, so it cannot be derived from the unit the way an .env can. The serial port, the MQTT address and the permit-join setting. The app refuses to start without it.

mosquitto.conf.note: Mosquitto listens on nothing but localhost unless this says otherwise.
